title: Towards the Harness of Embodied Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.11246v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The success of coding agents has established the harness as a paradigm: what an agent achieves depends not on the model alone, but on the infrastructure around it. We ask whether the same paradigm extends to embodied agents in the physical world. We present Thea, a harness in which an agentic loop orchestrates robot capabilities, each wrapped as a callable tool. It inherits the core components of coding agents, modified as the physical world requires. The world, however, withholds two abilities that software grants for free: reading the state of the world, and judging the outcome of an action. To bridge these gaps, Thea introduces Scene Graph as Context, a persistent, symbolic representation of the world, and Evaluation as Exit Codes, which detects when an action should terminate, judges whether it succeeded, and on failure diagnoses the cause. Together they close the loop between the agent and the physical world. Rich behaviors then eme

translated_title: 迈向具身智能体的驾驭框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11246v1 公告类型：新 摘要：编码智能体的成功确立了“驾驭”这一范式：智能体的成就不仅取决于模型本身，还取决于其周围的基础设施。我们探究这一范式是否同样适用于物理世界中的具身智能体。我们提出了Thea，一个驾驭框架，其中智能体循环编排机器人能力，每种能力都被封装为可调用的工具。它继承了编码智能体的核心组件，并根据物理世界的需求进行了修改。然而，物理世界保留了两项软件免费提供的能力：读取世界状态和判断行动结果。为弥合这些差距，Thea引入了“场景图作为上下文”，一种持久、符号化的世界表示，以及“评估作为退出代码”，用于检测行动何时应终止、判断其是否成功，并在失败时诊断原因。这两者共同闭环了智能体与物理世界之间的循环。丰富的行为随之涌现。
tldr: Thea通过引入场景图作为上下文和评估作为退出代码，为物理世界中的具身智能体建立了驾驭范式，弥合了状态读取和结果判断的鸿沟，从而实现了丰富的闭环行为。
en_tdlr: Thea establishes a harness paradigm for embodied agents in the physical world by introducing Scene Graph as Context and Evaluation as Exit Codes, bridging gaps in state reading and outcome judgment to enable rich closed-loop behaviors.
